scope: Paired descriptive replay of existing validation anchors. No fresh scenes, optimization, selection, or physical outcome claim.

action_target_contract.source: detached native future plan through op_tangent_v1 before mission braking, with measured state and vehicle limits

decision: Localize acceleration endpoint/secant residual before choosing a new experiment. This report does not change frozen thresholds.

array_contract.native_future_states: [anchor,201 native ticks,9 state columns], x,y,yaw,vx,vy,yaw_rate,steer,accel,timestamp. Absolute native timestamps are retained.
array_contract.*_nll_mu_gradient_scale: Absolute NLL derivative coefficient away from zero residual. Includes time/column normalization, excludes batch averaging and global w_plan.
array_contract.*_actions: [anchor, steer radians and clipped longitudinal request m/s^2], before mission layer
array_contract.*_longitudinal_components: [anchor, target speed, target tangent acceleration, speed feedback, unclipped command]
array_contract.*_residual_*_component_mps2: Projection onto native interval-average velocity direction and its left normal in OP xy. Consult native_direction_defined at zero speed.

limitations: Native future and teacher controls are offline labels only. The model receives camera features, desire and traffic inputs.
Teacher requests and native kinematic acceleration have different contracts. Their observed gap is not proof of the cause of model incoherence.
Uncertainty and residual correlation is descriptive. No optimizer gradient conflict or causality is established.
One deterministic replay has no repeatability or population uncertainty estimate. Correlated anchors are not independent physical trials.
All groups and intervals are reported. No new thresholds are fitted and this script cannot promote a checkpoint.
